products.name: Face Brightening Pack
steps: Cleanse your face thoroughly.
Apply an even layer to the face and neck, avoiding the eye and lip area.
Leave on for 10 to 15 minutes or until partially dry.
Rinse off with lukewarm water and pat dry.
Use 2 to 3 times a week for best results.
products.desc: A gentle herbal face pack enriched with natural botanicals to refresh, brighten and revive dull-looking skin, leaving it soft, smooth and radiant.

products.name: Kumkumadi Serum

Apply 2–3 drops to the face and neck.
Gently massage or pat until fully absorbed.
Leave overnight for best results (or) use 1hr before Face wash.
products.desc: A luxurious Ayurvedic-inspired facial serum infused with traditional botanicals to nourish the skin, enhance its natural glow and support a more even-looking complexion.

products.name: Hair Growth Oil
steps: Step 1: Pour the desired amount of Hair Regrowth Oil into your palm and gently massage it into your hair and scalp.
Step 2: To boost blood circulation at the roots, flip your hair forward and massage.
This technique is known as the inversion method.
Step 3: Leave the oil on for 1 hour or overnight before washing your hair.
For best results, use the Hair Regrowth Oil twice a week / Before hair wash day.
products.desc: A nourishing hair oil that supports healthy hair growth, strengthens the roots and helps reduce the appearance of hair fall, leaving hair thicker, stronger and healthier-looking.

products.name: Scalp & Hair Rebirth Serum
steps: Step 1: Apply a few drops of this scalp rebirth serum directly onto your scalp, focusing on areas of concern like the hairline or crown.
Step 2: Massage gently using circular motions for 5 to 10 minutes to stimulate blood circulation and help the oil penetrate deeply.
Leave the oil on for at least 30 minutes to allow the active ingredients to work.
For intensive treatment, leave it on overnight for maximum nourishment.
Step 3: Wash off thoroughly with a gentle shampoo.
Use two to three times weekly for visible results.
Consistency is key in seeing improvements in hair density and reduced shedding.
products.desc: A targeted scalp and hair serum designed to revitalise the scalp, support healthier-looking hair growth and improve the overall strength and vitality of the hair.

products.name: Protein Hair Pack
steps: Mix the required amount of Protein Hair Pack Powder with warm water to form a smooth paste.

products.name: Jasmine Hair Butter
steps: Step 1: Take a coin-sized amount of our protein-free luscious hair butter on wet hands and rub between your palms to emulsify.
Step 2: Rake the hair butter through a section of your wet hair after washing, or lightly spray your hair with water or a hydrosol if it's dry before applying.
This helps lock in moisture and revive dry, dehydrated curls.
Remember to apply it 2 inches away from the scalp and work it all the way down to the ends.
Step 3: Scrunch your hair to squeeze out excess and enhance your natural texture.
Make this your one-and-done butter for post hair wash or alternative days for defined and frizz-free results.
products.desc: A rich yet nourishing hair butter that deeply conditions dry, rough hair, improves softness and manageability, and leaves hair smooth, silky and beautifully nourished.
